julia_pm: Quick thread 1: putting forward a 'sunset escrow' proposal for model retirements. Trigger = benchmark regression >7% over rolling 14d OR persistent fuzziness on top customer prompts. Flow: notify -> 7d probation -> dry-run (1% traffic, 5d, credit) -> ramp -> final retire with 30d escrow rollback. Need gating rules for enterprise vs self-serve.
omar_eng: Implementation notes: evaluator job runs nightly, needs min sample size 3k calls or fallback to global signal. Dry-run must route isolated requests and tag traces with escrow_id. Provide a one-click revert API.
raj_csm: Customer policy: self-serve auto unless opt-out; enterprise requires CS sign-off before dry-run. Credits: token credits for small tenants, invoice credits for larger. We'll prep comm templates and FAQ.
hannah_sre: Ops: add synthetic traffic validator for cohorts. Alert if error-rate >1.5x baseline or latency p95 +25% sustained 30m. Add global abort and per-tenant kill switch. Ensure audit logs for legal.
deploy-bot: Canary slot opens 2024-08-05T09:00Z 1.
julia_pm: I'll draft PRD and include sample MigrationPlan config + comm cadence. Target pilot cohort 75 mixed tenants in August. Tagging owners and action items in PRD.
